agent.definition: This node represents an AI-driven software agent capable of autonomous or semi-autonomous action.

application.definition: This node represents a software application, service, or product (artifact).

contract.definition: This node represents, and resolves to, a smart contract.

delegate.definition: This node represents a voter in on-chain governance, who may or may not have been delegated voting power from others.

grant.definition: This node represents a grant program, funding allocation, or funding award.

group.definition: This node represents a logical grouping of multiple child nodes within an organizational structure.

org.definition: This node represents an organization or sub-organization within a larger entity.

person.definition: This node represents an individual human.

treasury.definition: This node represents an account for funds that are collectively owned and/or managed.

wallet.definition: This node's main purpose is to send, receive, and/or store funds.

committee.definition: A formal group with delegated authority to make decisions or provide oversight within a defined scope.

council.definition: A high-level governance body with broad strategic authority and stewardship responsibilities.

workgroup.definition: An operational team focused on executing tasks or work within a specific domain.
